claims.statement: For real symmetric A, sum over all 2x2 mixed coordinate minors squared equals sum_{i<j} lambda_i^2 lambda_j^2, and the analogous 3x3 sum equals sum_{i<j<k} lambda_i^2 lambda_j^2 lambda_k^2. Three eigenvalues of magnitude >=1 force respective lower bounds 3 and 1.
Three eigenvalues of magnitude >=1 do not force any fixed-size original-coordinate principal block to have a dimension-free positive lower bound on operator norm or quadratic coefficients.
claims.construction: Rank-three Walsh projections with spectrum (1,1,1,0,...) and every k x k principal block norm <=3k/n.
claims.scope: Refutes this structural bridge only, not the bounded-density conjecture.

claims.statement: In the Walsh family, nonzero 2x2 principal determinants equal 8/n^2 on exactly 3n^2/8 cross-class pairs and sum to 3; nonzero 3x3 principal determinants equal 16/n^3 on exactly n^3/16 distinct-class triples and sum to 1.

Two independent variables with density caps K1,K2 and a definite 2x2 quadratic block B, with arbitrary linear perturbation, produce an output density bounded by pi K1 K2 / sqrt(|det B|). The bound survives conditioning on all other original coordinates.
For the rank-three Walsh projection A_n and arbitrary independent input densities bounded by1, X^T A_n X has density sup norm <=2 sqrt(2) pi uniformly in n.
